decisions.hall_tu_include_resolution: Hall native_arena_motion.cpp and kinetic_boundary.cpp use Hall compile options (-O2 -DNDEBUG, no warning flags) but resolve raikou/* to native candidate003 headers, so the whole link has one definition of ArenaRateEntry/ArenaCount (native-v6.2 headers declare ArenaCount=electrode_heat::Count).
decisions.mfem_gap_pic_not_linked_separately: pic_boris and pic_kinetic_energy_J are already defined by native.o inside libpic_native_candidate003.a, compiled from mfem_gap_pic.cpp whose bytes (fa1511c2...) equal native-v6.2 mfem_gap_pic.cpp; linking that source again would duplicate every GapPic definition.
decisions.timing_wraps: four Hall motion-TU functions are link-wrapped only to accumulate wall time and call counts; each wrapper calls the real function with unchanged arguments.
